item_no.description: The line-item identifier (CLIN, SubCLIN/SLIN, or sequence number) for this row of the SF1449 Schedule of Supplies/Services, as printed in column '19. ITEM NO.' of the SF1449 form (or column '(A) ITEM NO.' on any attached Optional Form 336 'CONTINUATION SHEET' that continues the schedule). INCLUDE both top-level CLINs (typically 4 digits like '0001', '0002') AND any SubCLINs/SLINs printed as separate rows (typically 6 digits like '000101', '0001AA'). Label aliases: '19. ITEM NO.', '15A. ITEM NO.', 'ITEM NO.', 'ITEM NO. (A)', 'CLIN', 'SLIN', 'SUBCLIN'. Format requirement: copy the identifier VERBATIM from the page, preserving leading zeros, casing, and length exactly as printed (e.g. '0001', '000101', '1001AA'). Do NOT trim leading zeros (do NOT return '1' for '0001'). Do NOT add a '#' prefix. NULL semantics: if the SF1449 'ITEM NO.' column is genuinely blank for this entry (e.g. the schedule cell shows only narrative text or program name with no numeric identifier in column 19), return null. For RFP/solicitation documents where Section B.1 ('ITEMS BEING ACQUIRED') prints CLINs in a NARRATIVE list rather than in the Block 19-24 grid (e.g. 'CLIN 001 - Joule HPC...', 'CLIN 002 - Backup Storage...', 'SubCLIN 004 - Viewing/Visualization Requirement'), the printed CLIN code is the item_no — extract it VERBATIM as printed (e.g. 'CLIN 001' → '001', 'SubCLIN 004' → '004') WITHOUT the 'CLIN '/'SubCLIN ' prefix; preserve the original digit count even if shorter than 4 digits. Location hint: leftmost column of the Block 19-24 schedule grid on page 1 of the SF1449 form, plus any continuation pages (Optional Form 336 'CONTINUATION SHEET' with reference number matching the contract); also Section B.1 narrative CLIN listings on solicitations. Do NOT confuse with: (a) the CONTRACT NO. (block 2 — typically a long alphanumeric PIID like 'TOFS-16-D-0004' or 'DE-SOL-0011826'); (b) the REQUISITION NUMBER (block 1); (c) the ORDER NUMBER (block 4); (d) the SOLICITATION NUMBER (block 5); (e) any FAR clause number like '52.212-4' appearing in clauses pages; (f) sub-section identifiers like 'B.1', 'C.1' which are SECTION numbers not CLIN numbers; (g) the page-number 'PAGE OF' fields in the top-right corner of the cover sheet. [PATCH-v3 — blank item_no is valid for deliverable SLINs] NULL semantics REFINEMENT: blank `item_no` IS valid and EXPECTED for deliverable sub-rows printed within a parent CLIN's block in the Section B grid. Such rows have their own quantity / unit / unit_price / amount but no leftmost identifier. For these rows, return `item_no=null` AND set `parent_item_no` to the parent CLIN's item_no. DO emit them as separate ScheduleItem entries — they are not the same row as the parent CLIN. Composite identity (see repeated_structure.clin_items.identity_key) is `[parent_item_no, item_no, supplies_services]` so blank item_no + non-null parent_item_no + unique supplies_services title is uniquely addressable. NULL-vs-EMPTY-STRING CANONICALIZATION (universal): if the cell value is empty, whitespace-only, or otherwise contains no useful content after extraction, return JSON `null`. NEVER return an empty string `""`. The evaluator treats `null` and `""` as different values and using `""` blocks ground-truth generation downstream. This rule applies to every nullable scalar in this schema and OVERRIDES any preserve-verbatim guidance below for the specific case of an empty cell.

For all top-level CLINs (rows whose own ITEM NO cell is filled in), `parent_item_no` is null. [PATCH-v4 — parent_item_no is the nearest preceding filled ITEM NO] DETERMINISTIC RULE for `parent_item_no`: when this row's own ITEM NO is blank (deliverable sub-row), `parent_item_no` MUST be the `item_no` value of the NEAREST PRECEDING row in the same Section B grid whose ITEM NO column is FILLED IN. Walk upward from this row through the printed-grid order; the first row encountered whose ITEM NO is non-null is the parent. Example from PDF 0059 (FAI VA Services Platform): the Section B grid prints '00XX  XX  EA  $  $  Agile Delivery' as a parent CLIN row, and then 23 deliverable sub-rows below it (each with `1 LO NSP NSP <deliverable_title>` but no leftmost ITEM NO). For ALL 23 sub-rows, `parent_item_no` MUST be `'00XX'` (the nearest preceding filled ITEM NO), NOT `'0001'` or any other prior CLIN's item_no. CRITICAL: do NOT use the deliverable's serial position number (e.g. the first deliverable's '1' in the QUANTITY column) as parent_item_no; parent_item_no is always copied verbatim from a PRECEDING ITEM NO cell, never derived from a different column or from row position.

supplies_services.description:
The short product/service title printed at the TOP of this item's '20. SCHEDULE OF SUPPLIES/SERVICES' cell — the first one or two lines that name what is being acquired for this line. Examples of correct values: 'Legal Support Services - Base Year', 'Legal Support Services - Option Year 1', 'Joule High Performance Computing (HPC) System Requirement (3-year lease)', 'Backup Storage Requirement (single purchase during year 1)', 'TARP Acquisition Support Blanket Purchase Agreement'. Where the item is a CLIN with a parenthetical period qualifier on the same heading line (e.g. 'Legal Support Services - Option Year 2'), include the qualifier as part of the title. Where the cover schedule of an RFP names the CLIN in Section B.1 NARRATIVE (e.g. 'CLIN 001 - Joule High Performance Computing (HPC) System Requirement (3-year lease)' followed on the next line by '$(TBD)/Month'), the supplies_services title is the text AFTER the CLIN code dash (e.g. 'Joule High Performance Computing (HPC) System Requirement (3-year lease)') — do NOT include the leading 'CLIN 001 - ' prefix (that is the item_no); also do NOT include the '$(TBD)' price/period qualifier on the following line (that goes into the price columns or description). Label aliases: '20. SCHEDULE OF SUPPLIES/SERVICES', '15B. SUPPLIES/SERVICES', 'SUPPLIES/SERVICES', 'SUPPLIES/SERVICES (B)'. Format requirement: preserve internal punctuation, hyphens, parentheses, and the original casing verbatim; collapse a soft line wrap inside the title into a single space. NULL semantics: if the schedule cell for this item is BLANK with no title line printed (only price-column data, no service-name text in the SUPPLIES/SERVICES column), return null. Do NOT confuse with: (a) the long narrative description body that follows the title (e.g. 'Base Year Fully Burdened Labor Rates:\nPartner: (b)(4) per Hour\nAssociate: (b)(4) per Hour ...' — those belong in `description`); (b) the document-level title 'SOLICITATION/CONTRACT/ORDER FOR COMMERCIAL ITEMS' or 'SOLICITATION/CONTRACT/ORDER FOR COMMERCIAL ITEM' printed at the top of the SF1449 cover page; (c) section headings like 'SECTION B - SUPPLIES OR SERVICES/PRICES'; (d) PRIME/SUB contractor name lines (e.g. 'PRIME:', 'SUB:', 'Small Business Administration', '807372839', 'INTEGRATED FEDERAL SOLUTIONS INC.') that some BPA cover sheets print into block 20 to identify parties rather than priced items — those are CONTRACTOR-IDENTIFICATION lines, NOT priced supplies/services, and do NOT constitute a separate schedule item; (e) Period-of-Performance lines (e.g. 'Period of Performance: 03/09/2012 to 03/08/2015', 'Base Year - 3/9/2012 through 3/8/2013') printed in block 20 — those are POP rows that document the contract term, NOT priced supplies/services, and should NEVER appear as their own ScheduleItem (omit them entirely from clin_items). [PATCH-v3 — blank-item_no deliverable rows] For blank-item_no deliverable SLIN rows (see item_no description's blank-item_no clause), `supplies_services` is the deliverable's printed name (e.g. 'Stable Pre-Production Environments', 'Automated Pipelines', 'ATO Documentation'). These are first-class titles for their own row, not continuations of the parent CLIN's title. See the list-level row-boundary rule for page-break handling. [PATCH-v4 — title-below-item-no layout on OF-336 continuation pattern] On the SF1449 / OF-336 continuation form, many PDFs print the row using a TWO-LINE pattern: line A is the grid columns 'ITEM_NO  QTY  UNIT  UNIT_PRICE  AMOUNT' (e.g. '0011 6.00 EA'), and line B is the supplies_services title alone (e.g. 'Scanner Kit EX1902HC-FV5'). This title-below pattern means the row's title text appears on the NEXT TEXT LINE below the ITEM NO grid line, not on the same line as the ITEM NO cell. ROW BINDING RULE (deterministic, OVERRIDES any positional-alignment heuristic): the title text on line B belongs to the row whose ITEM NO is on line A, NOT to the row whose ITEM NO appears on the line C below line B. Example from PDF 0003 page 4-5 (a real, common layout): line `0011 6.00 EA` is followed on the next line by `Scanner Kit EX1902HC-FV5`, which is the title for row 0011 (NOT row 0012). The lines that follow are `0012 6.00 EA` then `Electronic Signature Pad T-S261-HSB-R` — that pair is row 0012. This rule applies EVEN ACROSS A PAGE BREAK: if line A ends a page and line B (the title) is the FIRST data line at the top of the next page (immediately under the column-header repeat), line B is still the title for row A. NEVER shift the title down one row just because the title sits on a separate line, on a new page, or in a different table sub-cell. [PATCH-v5 — strict title-only on multi-paragraph CLIN cells] STRICT TITLE-ONLY RULE FOR MULTI-PARAGRAPH BLOCK 20 CELLS: when a CLIN's Block 20 'SCHEDULE OF SUPPLIES/SERVICES' cell contains MULTIPLE paragraphs (common pattern: a one-line product/service title in bold/larger type, followed by a free-text narrative body of one or more paragraphs that may include labor-rate breakdowns, delivery dates, deliverables enumeration, or per-CLIN clauses), `supplies_services` captures ONLY the first paragraph (the product/service title line). Every subsequent paragraph in the SAME Block 20 cell — regardless of length, regardless of whether it begins with a colon-headed label like 'Partner:' or 'Delivery:' or 'Obligated Amount:', regardless of whether it appears to continue the title's subject — belongs to `description`, NOT to `supplies_services`. NEVER concatenate the title paragraph with body paragraphs into a single `supplies_services` value. WORKED EXAMPLE (PDF 0059 Agile Delivery CLIN 0001 pattern): Block 20 prints the line 'Agile Delivery — Base Period' as the title, then a body paragraph starting 'The contractor shall provide ...' which lists 23 deliverable sub-items. `supplies_services` = 'Agile Delivery — Base Period' (title only). `description` = the full body paragraph(s) including the deliverables enumeration. Each deliverable that is printed AS ITS OWN ROW in the price-table grid (with its own qty/unit/price columns and a blank ITEM NO) is a separate ScheduleItem with its own supplies_services title — see the blank-item_no deliverable-SLIN clause and the parent_item_no field.

description.description: The narrative body printed inside this item's '20. SCHEDULE OF SUPPLIES/SERVICES' cell AFTER the title line captured in `supplies_services` and BEFORE the next ITEM NO heading (or before Section C / Section H / Block 25 'ACCOUNTING AND APPROPRIATION DATA'). Typically contains: labor-rate breakdowns (e.g. 'Partner: (b)(4) per Hour\nAssociate: (b)(4) per Hour\nParalegal: (b)(4) per Hour'), 'Obligated Amount: $0.00' / 'Amount: $0.00 (Option Line Item)', 'Delivery: 01/14/2016' lines, and any per-CLIN free text like 'The contractor shall ...'. For solicitation-style RFP documents where Section B.1 prints each CLIN as a narrative paragraph with only a period/price qualifier (e.g. CLIN 001 followed by '$(TBD)/Month'), this field is the pricing/period qualifier line (e.g. '$(TBD)/Month') — preserve it verbatim using the canonical no-space token. Format requirement: concatenate every narrative line inside this item's schedule cell into a SINGLE STRING with a single space between successive lines (collapse hard newlines to a single space and collapse runs of whitespace). Preserve verbatim casing, punctuation, embedded labels (e.g. 'Partner:', 'Delivery:', 'Obligated Amount:'), and any redaction tokens (e.g. '(b)(4)'). WHITESPACE CANONICALIZATION (REQUIRED, applies to every doc-type and OVERRIDES the generic 'preserve verbatim punctuation' rule for these specific placeholder tokens): Collapse any whitespace that appears between `$` and the following `(` in `$(TBD)` / `$(amount)` / `$(estimate)` placeholder tokens. The PDF may print these with a literal space character (e.g. '$ (TBD)', '$ (TBD)/Month') because of form-field rendering quirks — do NOT preserve that literal space. The canonical token form is '$(TBD)' or '$(TBD)/Month' with NO space between the `$` and the `(`. Likewise canonicalize '$ TBD' to '$TBD' if that variant appears without parentheses. DO NOT repeat the title line already captured in `supplies_services`. DO NOT include the 'Delivery:' / 'Period of Performance:' lines that print OUTSIDE the per-CLIN block (e.g. the standalone 'Period of Performance: 01/14/2016 to 01/13/2021' that some forms print once for the whole contract above CLIN 0001) — only narrative inside the same boxed schedule cell as the CLIN. NULL semantics: if the cell contains ONLY the title (no narrative body and no labor-rate breakdown and no embedded 'Delivery:'/'Obligated Amount:' line), return null. Do NOT confuse with: (a) Section C 'DESCRIPTION/SPECIFICATIONS' / Statement of Work text (that is a separate document section, not the per-CLIN schedule description); (b) Section F 'DELIVERIES OR PERFORMANCE' which describes contract-wide delivery terms; (c) Section H 'SPECIAL CONTRACT REQUIREMENTS'; (d) the BPA Scope-of-Agreement narrative on later pages of a BPA (e.g. the 'TARP Acquisition Support' background/scope/objectives paragraphs in a Treasury BPA) — that prose lives in subsequent body pages, not inside the Block 19-24 grid, and does NOT belong to any ScheduleItem.description. REDACTED values: if the UNIT PRICE cell shows '(b)(4)' / '(b) (4)' text or a solid black redaction rectangle, return the canonical token '(b)(4)'. NULL semantics: return null if column 23 is genuinely empty (no number, no redaction marker, no placeholder text) — common on BPA cover sheets where pricing is task-order-driven. CRITICAL DOC-TYPE CLAUSE (RFP / solicitation handling, SUPERSEDES all other guidance): on an SF1449 SOLICITATION where the Block 19-24 schedule grid is BLANK for this row AND the only printed pricing qualifier (e.g. '$(TBD)', '$(TBD)/Month', '$ (TBD)', '$ (TBD)/Month', 'TBD', '$ TBD') appears in the Section B.1 NARRATIVE paragraph for the CLIN, `unit_price` MUST be null. The '$(TBD)' / 'TBD' qualifier text belongs ONLY in `description` — NEVER copy it into `unit_price`. This rule applies to every CLIN whose `item_no` was extracted from a Section B.1 narrative paragraph rather than from a populated row of the Block 19-24 grid. It is intentional that on RFP-style solicitations the entire `unit_price` column will read null for every CLIN — that is the correct, deterministic answer because the grid column is genuinely blank. CRITICAL — when the row collapses to a single visible dollar value: the SF1449 grid has TWO money columns (23 UNIT PRICE and 24 AMOUNT). If only one dollar amount is visible in the row, locate which column it sits under by horizontal position before assigning: a number aligned under the rightmost AMOUNT column is `amount`, not `unit_price`. When unit price is redacted but amount is visible (a frequent FOIA-pattern), unit_price=`(b)(4)` and amount holds the visible value. contract_number.description: The contract / order PIID printed in block 2 'CONTRACT NO.' of the SF1449 form cover sheet. Examples: 'TOFS-16-D-0004', 'TOFS-12-B-0005 / 0353/12/201160', 'W911QY20P0195'. Label aliases: '2. CONTRACT NO.', '2. CONTRACT (Proc. Inst. Ident.) NO.', 'CONTRACT NO.'. Format requirement: copy VERBATIM from block 2 exactly as printed, preserving internal slashes, hyphens, spaces and casing (e.g. 'TOFS-12-B-0005/\n0353/12/201160' may be rendered across two lines — collapse soft line wraps into a single space, preserving the slash separators). Do NOT append the contract administration office code (e.g. 'ARC/ASD/OFS') or any modification suffix. clin_items.description:
Ordered list of every line item that appears in the 'SCHEDULE OF SUPPLIES/SERVICES' for this SF1449 document. The schedule lives in (a) the Block 19-24 grid on the cover page of the SF1449 form, and (b) any attached Optional Form 336 'CONTINUATION SHEET' or Section B 'SUPPLIES OR SERVICES/PRICES' page that continues or restates the cover-page schedule. Each entry is one ScheduleItem row (see ROW BOUNDARIES in the PATCH-v3 clause below — a row may be either a printed-ITEM-NO row OR a blank-item_no deliverable sub-row beneath a parent CLIN). Order: preserve the on-page order — cover-page rows first (0001, 0002, ...), then continuation-sheet rows in printed order. INCLUDE: (i) priced lines (with explicit unit_price and amount), (ii) Not-Separately-Priced ('NSP') deliverable lines, (iii) Option Year line items even if amount is $0.00 (e.g. CLINs 0002-0005 'Legal Support Services - Option Year 1/2/3/4'), (iv) lines whose money columns are FOIA-redacted ('(b)(4)' / black-box), (v) RFP/solicitation CLINs printed in Section B.1 NARRATIVE (e.g. 'CLIN 001 - Joule HPC System Requirement (3-year lease) $(TBD)/Month') — for those, item_no is the printed CLIN code without the 'CLIN '/'SubCLIN ' prefix and the '$(TBD)' qualifier goes in `description` only; `unit_price` remains `null` unless column 23 is populated with a real numeric value. EXCLUDE: (a) PRIME/SUB contractor identification lines that some BPA cover sheets type into block 20 (e.g. 'PRIME: Small Business Administration', 'SUB: 807372839 INTEGRATED FEDERAL SOLUTIONS INC. 1818 LIBRARY ST STE 500 RESTON VA 20190-6274', and the trailing program-name label 'Troubled Asset Relief Program (TARP) Acquisition Support Blanket Purchase Agreement') — those are CONTRACTOR-IDENTIFICATION / SCOPE-LABEL text, not priced supplies/services, and DO NOT constitute a ScheduleItem; (b) Period-of-Performance lines printed in block 20 above CLIN 0001 (e.g. 'Base Year - 3/9/2012 through 3/8/2013', 'Period of Performance: 01/14/2016 to 01/13/2021', 'Option Year One - 3/9/2013 through 3/8/2014') — these are contract-wide POP rows, not per-item rows; (c) the Section C 'DESCRIPTION/SPECIFICATIONS' or 'STATEMENT OF WORK' narrative; (d) Section F deliveries; (e) Section H special clauses; (f) Section I FAR clauses by reference; (g) attached appendices, attachments, certifications, and conflict-of-interest forms; (h) any per-CLIN 'Accounting Info:' / cost-code lines printed above CLIN 0001. EMPTY SCHEDULE: if the SF1449 grid is intentionally blank AND there is no Section B narrative listing of CLINs (e.g. a pure BPA cover sheet whose schedule names only the program with no priced items and no narrative line-item enumeration anywhere in the document), return an empty list `[]`. Identity for each row: see repeated_structure.clin_items.identity_key — the composite `[parent_item_no, item_no, supplies_services]` (NOT plain item_no alone, since blank-item_no deliverable SLINs need lineage + title to be distinguishable).

[PATCH-v3 — Section B boundary + deliverable SLINs + lineage + page-break]
INCLUDE every priced or NSP-placeholder row that physically sits INSIDE the Section B Price Schedule grid (or its OF-336 continuation), REGARDLESS of whether the leftmost ITEM NO column is filled in. Specifically: deliverable sub-rows printed beneath a parent CLIN (e.g. on the FAI VA Services Platform pattern, parent CLIN '0001 — Agile Delivery' contains 23 deliverable rows such as 'Stable Pre-Production Environments', 'Automated Pipelines', 'ATO Documentation' each printed with its own qty / unit / unit_price / amount columns but with a BLANK item_no) ARE separate ScheduleItem entries in this list. Their `item_no` is null; their `parent_item_no` is the parent CLIN's item_no (e.g. '0001'); their other fields are extracted from the printed row.

EXCLUDE narrative menus of available tasks that live OUTSIDE the Section B Price Schedule grid: Section C 'STATEMENT OF WORK' / 'DESCRIPTION/SPECIFICATIONS', Section H 'SPECIAL CONTRACT REQUIREMENTS', Section L 'INSTRUCTIONS TO OFFERORS', Section M 'EVALUATION CRITERIA', PWS / SOW task listings, attachments, the document table of contents, and any 'Optional Task N — <title>' menu paragraphs printed in PWS prose. The positional test is the boundary heading: a row counts ONLY if its grid line is between the 'SECTION B' / 'SCHEDULE OF SUPPLIES/SERVICES' / 'PRICE SCHEDULE' heading and the next major-section heading (typically 'SECTION C' or 'SECTION D'). Tasks named identically in PWS text are NOT separate clin_items entries — the deliverable rows IN Section B are the schedule; the PWS prose is a scope reference, not a price-table row.

ROW BOUNDARIES (page-break safe, simpler restatement of v2's row rule): a row STARTS at either (a) a printed ITEM NO cell in the leftmost column, or (b) for a blank-item_no deliverable sub-row, at the next printed qty/unit/unit_price/amount line inside the Section B grid below the parent CLIN's columns. A row ENDS at the next row-start boundary (a) or (b), or at the end of Section B (next major-section heading). EVERY text or column value printed between a row's start and its next boundary belongs to that row — including text that wraps across a page break. NEVER split a row at a page break. NEVER reassign continuation text to the next row just because the continuation begins at the top of a new page.

IDENTITY: each row's identity for downstream alignment is the composite `[parent_item_no, item_no, supplies_services]` (see repeated_structure.clin_items.identity_key). For top-level CLINs `parent_item_no` is null; for deliverable sub-rows `parent_item_no` is the parent CLIN's `item_no` string and `item_no` is null.

[PATCH-v4 — additional EXCLUDE guidance + Section B start rule]

EXCLUDE (additional cases observed in real PDFs):
(I) Period-of-Performance / Accounting-Info narrative blocks printed in column 20 ABOVE the first CLIN row. On some IDIQ continuation sheets (e.g. PDF 0042), the second page of the SF1449 begins with a block 20 cell that contains 'Option Year 2: ...', 'Option Year 3: ...', 'Total Potential Period of Performance: ...', and 'Accounting Info: -61000001---XXXXXXXXXX-...' BEFORE the first CLIN row ('0001 Legal Support Services - Base Year') appears. ALL of this above-CLIN-0001 narrative is NOT a ScheduleItem and MUST NOT be emitted as a separate row. The Section B grid starts at the first row whose ITEM NO cell is FILLED IN.
(II) PWS / SOW / CDRL deliverable-listing pages that LOOK LIKE table rows but are OUTSIDE Section B. On PDF 0059, pages 4 and 50-90 print a CDRL-style listing of deliverable titles ('Monthly Progress Report', 'Sprint Reports', 'ATO Documentation', 'Stable pre-production environments', ...) and a parallel PWS section listing 'Optional Task 1 – Platform Operations and Maintenance', 'Optional Task 1.a.', etc. These titles look almost identical to deliverable sub-row titles in the Section B grid (sometimes differing only in casing or '–' vs '-'), but they are PWS/CDRL listings, NOT priced rows. They are EXCLUDED. The positional test (between 'SECTION B' heading and next major-section heading) is authoritative; the title-similarity-to-Section-B-row test is NOT.
(III) TOC and table-of-deliverables-summary pages that enumerate deliverables without QUANTITY/UNIT/UNIT_PRICE/AMOUNT columns. If a candidate row has all of qty/unit/unit_price/amount null AND its location is outside the priced-grid heading boundaries, it is NOT a ScheduleItem.

SECTION B START RULE: the first ScheduleItem in clin_items is the row at the FIRST printed ITEM NO cell after the 'SECTION B' / 'SCHEDULE OF SUPPLIES/SERVICES' / 'PRICE SCHEDULE' / 'PRICE/COST SCHEDULE' heading (or, on legacy SF1449 cover pages without an explicit Section B heading, the first ITEM NO cell in the Block 19-24 grid). Any narrative text that appears between the heading and the first ITEM NO cell is preamble (POP, Accounting Info, contract-wide notes) — preamble is NEVER a ScheduleItem.

[PATCH-v3 — Section B boundary + deliverable SLINs + lineage + page-break]
INCLUDE every priced or NSP-placeholder row that physically sits INSIDE the Section B Price Schedule grid (or its OF-336 continuation), REGARDLESS of whether the leftmost ITEM NO column is filled in. Specifically: deliverable sub-rows printed beneath a parent CLIN (e.g. on the FAI VA Services Platform pattern, parent CLIN '0001 — Agile Delivery' contains 23 deliverable rows such as 'Stable Pre-Production Environments', 'Automated Pipelines', 'ATO Documentation' each printed with its own qty / unit / unit_price / amount columns but with a BLANK item_no) ARE separate ScheduleItem entries in this list. Their `item_no` is null; their `parent_item_no` is the parent CLIN's item_no (e.g. '0001'); their other fields are extracted from the printed row.

EXCLUDE narrative menus of available tasks that live OUTSIDE the Section B Price Schedule grid: Section C 'STATEMENT OF WORK' / 'DESCRIPTION/SPECIFICATIONS', Section H 'SPECIAL CONTRACT REQUIREMENTS', Section L 'INSTRUCTIONS TO OFFERORS', Section M 'EVALUATION CRITERIA', PWS / SOW task listings, attachments, the document table of contents, and any 'Optional Task N — <title>' menu paragraphs printed in PWS prose. The positional test is the boundary heading: a row counts ONLY if its grid line is between the 'SECTION B' / 'SCHEDULE OF SUPPLIES/SERVICES' / 'PRICE SCHEDULE' heading and the next major-section heading (typically 'SECTION C' or 'SECTION D'). Tasks named identically in PWS text are NOT separate clin_items entries — the deliverable rows IN Section B are the schedule; the PWS prose is a scope reference, not a price-table row.

ROW BOUNDARIES (page-break safe, simpler restatement of v2's row rule): a row STARTS at either (a) a printed ITEM NO cell in the leftmost column, or (b) for a blank-item_no deliverable sub-row, at the next printed qty/unit/unit_price/amount line inside the Section B grid below the parent CLIN's columns. A row ENDS at the next row-start boundary (a) or (b), or at the end of Section B (next major-section heading). EVERY text or column value printed between a row's start and its next boundary belongs to that row — including text that wraps across a page break. NEVER split a row at a page break. NEVER reassign continuation text to the next row just because the continuation begins at the top of a new page.

IDENTITY: each row's identity for downstream alignment is the composite `[parent_item_no, item_no, supplies_services]` (see repeated_structure.clin_items.identity_key). For top-level CLINs `parent_item_no` is null; for deliverable sub-rows `parent_item_no` is the parent CLIN's `item_no` string and `item_no` is null.

[PATCH-v4 — additional EXCLUDE guidance + Section B start rule]

EXCLUDE (additional cases observed in real PDFs):
(I) Period-of-Performance / Accounting-Info narrative blocks printed in column 20 ABOVE the first CLIN row. On some IDIQ continuation sheets (e.g. PDF 0042), the second page of the SF1449 begins with a block 20 cell that contains 'Option Year 2: ...', 'Option Year 3: ...', 'Total Potential Period of Performance: ...', and 'Accounting Info: -61000001---XXXXXXXXXX-...' BEFORE the first CLIN row ('0001 Legal Support Services - Base Year') appears. ALL of this above-CLIN-0001 narrative is NOT a ScheduleItem and MUST NOT be emitted as a separate row. The Section B grid starts at the first row whose ITEM NO cell is FILLED IN.
(II) PWS / SOW / CDRL deliverable-listing pages that LOOK LIKE table rows but are OUTSIDE Section B. On PDF 0059, pages 4 and 50-90 print a CDRL-style listing of deliverable titles ('Monthly Progress Report', 'Sprint Reports', 'ATO Documentation', 'Stable pre-production environments', ...) and a parallel PWS section listing 'Optional Task 1 – Platform Operations and Maintenance', 'Optional Task 1.a.', etc. These titles look almost identical to deliverable sub-row titles in the Section B grid (sometimes differing only in casing or '–' vs '-'), but they are PWS/CDRL listings, NOT priced rows. They are EXCLUDED. The positional test (between 'SECTION B' heading and next major-section heading) is authoritative; the title-similarity-to-Section-B-row test is NOT.
(III) TOC and table-of-deliverables-summary pages that enumerate deliverables without QUANTITY/UNIT/UNIT_PRICE/AMOUNT columns. If a candidate row has all of qty/unit/unit_price/amount null AND its location is outside the priced-grid heading boundaries, it is NOT a ScheduleItem.

SECTION B START RULE: the first ScheduleItem in clin_items is the row at the FIRST printed ITEM NO cell after the 'SECTION B' / 'SCHEDULE OF SUPPLIES/SERVICES' / 'PRICE SCHEDULE' / 'PRICE/COST SCHEDULE' heading (or, on legacy SF1449 cover pages without an explicit Section B heading, the first ITEM NO cell in the Block 19-24 grid). Any narrative text that appears between the heading and the first ITEM NO cell is preamble (POP, Accounting Info, contract-wide notes) — preamble is NEVER a ScheduleItem.
